vi.title: Khám phá hàm số và biến đổi đồ thị
vi.description: Thay đổi tham số để quan sát phép tịnh tiến, co giãn, đối xứng, tập xác định và tập giá trị của các hàm số cơ bản.

ui.predictionGraphContext: Đồ thị kết quả dự đoán
ui.graphSubtitle: Đường cong, điểm đặc trưng và tiệm cận dùng chung một hệ tọa độ.

ui.resetViewportMessage: Đã khôi phục góc nhìn; phép biến đổi được giữ nguyên.
ui.overlapBannerPrefix: Đồ thị g đang trùng với đồ thị hàm nền f trong trường hợp này.

ui.graphDescAsymptoteStyle: dùng nét đứt màu đỏ sẫm.

ui.pinTouchMessage: Chạm lần nữa hoặc dùng nút Ghim điểm để ghim.

ui.clearedReadoutMessage: Đã xóa điểm đọc tọa độ.
ui.sameValueText: Hai đồ thị có cùng giá trị tại điểm này.

en.title: Explore functions and graph transformations
en.description: Change parameters to observe translation, stretch/compression, reflection, domain and range of basic functions.

ui.graphSubtitle: Curves, characteristic points and asymptotes share one coordinate system.
ui.fitMessage: Fitted the view to the meaningful graph content.
ui.resetViewportMessage: Viewport reset; the transformation is kept.
ui.overlapBannerPrefix: The graph of g overlaps the graph of the base function f in this case.
ui.graphDescIdentity: The graph shows the base function f; no transformation has been applied.
ui.graphDescTransformed: The graph of the base function f is a grey dashed line; the transformed graph g is a solid indigo line.
ui.graphDescNoConnect: Undefined points are never connected across each other.
ui.graphDescAsymptoteStyle: use a dark red dashed line.
ui.graphDescReader: Use the left and right arrow keys to read coordinates; Enter pins and Escape unpins.
ui.pinTouchMessage: Tap again or use the Pin point button to pin.
ui.sameValueText: Both graphs have the same value at this point.
ui.readerIdleText: Hover near a curve, tap it, or use the ← → keys on the graph.
ui.valueTableCaptionIdentity: A few finite values of the base function
ui.valueTableCaptionTransformed: A few finite values of the transformed graph
ui.concealedFormulaText: Complete the prediction to reveal the result formula.
ui.concealQuestionsText: Answer the questions to reveal the result graph.
ui.identityExploreText: Choose a parameter or manipulate the graph directly to start exploring.
ui.imageOfSourcePoint: This is the image of a characteristic point from the base function.
ui.derivedIntersection: This is an intersection derived directly from the transformed function.
ui.coordinatesFromModel: Coordinates are computed from the same model as the graph.
ui.pedagogicalOrderNote: The order above is a pedagogical order for observation, not a license to arbitrarily swap algebraic transformations.
ui.noReviewConceptsText: None — every prediction matches the model.

parameterDescriptions.a: |a| stretches/compresses vertically; negative a reflects across Ox.
parameterDescriptions.b: |b| acts horizontally by the reciprocal; negative b reflects across Oy.
parameterDescriptions.h: Positive h in f(x − h) shifts the graph to the right.
parameterDescriptions.k: Positive k shifts the graph upward.

ui.readerLockedHint: Coordinate reading becomes available after the result graph is revealed.
ui.dragModeGroupLabel: Choose what dragging on the graph does
ui.setLinesTitle: Number lines and table of values
ui.legendPointMapping: Point on f → image on g
ui.resultGraphShownText: The result graph g now appears in the graph frame, together with the base function f.
